fact: The ministry's 2022-2024 programme document lists putting in place the SIGE and extending it to secondary education, financed by the World Bank GPE project, with the expected result that computerisation is introduced in primary schools.
title: DPPD initial 2022-2024 du Ministère des Enseignements Maternel et Primaire
publisher: Ministère des Enseignements Maternel et Primaire (République du Bénin)
